mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing beautiful clear skies with a temperature of seventy-seven degrees that feels like eighty-two, making it perfect for a walk around Reddan Soccer Park. Tonight is also a great night for stargazing under a Waxing Crescent moon, especially since the ISS will make a visible pass starting at nine thirty-one PM for six minutes.

In city news, Verona is highlighting several sustainability programs, including apartment composting drop-offs at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue, and Alliant Energy's community solar options. Additionally, residents can take advantage of city rebates for rain barrels, energy-efficient toilets, and rain gardens to manage stormwater.

We have plenty of community happenings coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run and the Mount Horeb Art Fair on July nineteenth, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness on July twentieth, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on July twenty-second.

In the weekly police report, on Friday, July tenth, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle collision at Old PB and Whalen Road. A twenty-four-year-old cyclist sustained minor injuries, and a forty-nine-year-old Verona man was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Wrap up your day with a delicious trip to Culver's, where today's flavor of the day is Turtle, featuring hot fudge, hot caramel, and toasted pecans. They are open for another ten hours until ten PM tonight, and if you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
